description: Crew weight exceeded the aircraft limit (2,900+ lbs) when reweighed at the Resolute hangar, requiring immediate gear triage.
response: All crew and equipment were individually reweighed; personal gear was reduced and group gear assessed by mission criticality. Final weight: 2,740 lbs.
lesson: Build the weight calculator 4+ weeks before departure. Conduct a test weigh with ALL crew and gear assembled — not at home airports. One person (the XO) must hold final authority for weight cuts.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.3 Operational incidents, lines 632-637. Register Crew tag: 'C16'. Sol: occurred at the Resolute hangar reweigh, before landing on Devon Island; sol 0 placeholder, consistent with the Resolute weather-delay entry. Confidence (B) rationale: specific figures (2,900/2,740 lbs) but presented as narrative logistics account rather than a formal engineering report.
